material_gate: full opaque coverage, not transparent-sprite perimeter gate
seam_status: not claimed seamless; periodic difference measured without offset, blur, edge lock or paint

visual_review.identity: Broad connected pale snow sheets interrupted by exposed muted olive-brown earth, small gray stones and dry ochre/olive tuft groups. Defining mixed snow/earth/grass identity retained, no water or invented objects.
visual_review.detail_density: About 20-25 tuft or stone accent groups, somewhat above proposal. Tuft leaves are grouped broad shapes, and much of the snow is connected, with more shallow facet subdivisions than 6-12 total regions.
visual_review.scale_caveat: Tufts and stone groups often span about 12-25 world units at the proposed 256 period, larger than 3-8-unit guidance. Sparse coverage rather than fine grass carpet.
visual_review.composition_caveat: One irregular exposed-earth ribbon runs down the central region and diagonally to the lower right. This is texture coverage, not an authored route or gameplay corridor; the repeated preview should be reviewed for an unintended path-like reading.
visual_review.style_caveat: Broad chunky matte snow and vegetation; earth has some small tonal patches. Main snow palette is brighter/bluer than the original while olive exposed ground is retained.
visual_review.native_acceptance: 1254 opaque native identity candidate; catalog-only with no scene binding or seamlessness claim.

reference_material_identity: Patchy cool pale snow interleaved with exposed muted olive-brown earth and numerous dry ochre/olive grass tufts, plus small stones. The snow/earth contrast and remaining dry vegetation are defining, rather than uniform snow coverage.
period_status: candidate parent integration parameter, not bound by this source handoff
